titolo: Mercor secures $750M Series D at $20B valuation as Gemini 4 Carbon tops paid chat rankings
descr: Mercor raises $750M to expand AI agent evaluation for enterprises; Gemini 4 Carbon named top paid chat model.
paragrafi: Mercor.io Corp. announced a $750 million Series D funding round that values the company at $20 billion.
The round, which included corporate investors Nvidia, Salesforce and Zoom, follows a $350 million Series C in October 2025 that valued Mercor at $10 billion.
The company plans to use the new capital to build custom benchmarks for enterprise customers, extending its frontier‑lab services to every industry.
Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon model is currently ranked the best paid chat model on FreeLLMArena, scoring 1526 points in the latest blind vote.
perche: Enterprises seeking reliable AI agents now have a dedicated service that can tailor evaluations to their specific workflows, potentially reducing risk and improving adoption.
